description: Manage organizations, users and memberships; read SSO connections, directories and events.

workos_new_connection_trigger.description: Runs for each new connection in WorkOS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

workos_new_directory_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new directory group in WorkOS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

workos_new_directory_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new directory user in WorkOS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

workos_new_or_updated_connection_trigger.description: Runs for each connection added or changed in WorkOS. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
